subject: Operations
title: The Rise of Agile
description: A quick, practical guide to The Rise of Agile.

hook.text: In 2001, 17 software developers met at a ski lodge and wrote a manifesto that changed how the world works.

buildup.text: Traditional project management followed a plan rigidly. Agile embraced change and delivered in short sprints.

discovery.text: Work in small batches, get feedback fast, adapt constantly. The opposite of the waterfall approach.

twist.text: Agile escaped software. Manufacturing, marketing, even the military now run agile-inspired operations.

climax.text: Agile proved that flexibility beats rigidity when the environment changes faster than plans can keep up.

punchline.text: Plan less, deliver more, adapt always.

quiz.question: What does Agile prioritize over following a rigid plan?
